svg.aria-label: Before: a shell loop of git pull stops on local changes, conflicts and deleted repos. After: chitragit sync updates 412 repos in parallel, keeps local changes, never merges diverged repos and keeps vanished repos safe.
svg.text: $ for d in */; do (cd "$d" && git pull); done
error: Your local changes would be overwritten by merge.
... 463 more repos, one at a time
✓ 412 repos updated in 3m 08s, 8 at a time
